account_specification.speaker_reference: Attributed speaker or explicitly identifiable authorial voice; never pool rival voices.
account_specification.future_statement: Source-supported educational arrangement, with primary/secondary position retained.
account_specification.role_details: Object keyed by each assigned future_role code; each value has mechanism, direction, conditions and evidence_reference strings. Missing details = not specified.
account_specification.evaluation_target: Precisely what arrangement or effect the evaluation concerns, not AI in general.
account_specification.stance: Source wording for endorsement/refusal/recommendation; not specified if absent. Refusal does not determine valence.
account_specification.qualification: Conditions/safeguards and mixed-effect explanation, or not specified.
account_specification.field_evidence: Object with all twelve field keys. Each substantive field code has one or more entries: {code, char_start, char_end, proposition_id, reason} for new records, locating a nonempty contiguous retained-source span without copying it. Previously stored {code, quote, proposition_id, reason} entries remain valid and unchanged. MISSING has an empty evidence array and a field-specific absence/limit note. Noneligible records have empty accounts/codes.
account_specification.propositions: Nonempty array per eligible account: {proposition_id, statement, target, claim_mode}. IDs unique within account. The statement is a source-supported semantic summary; no assigned code or evaluation is inferred from claim_mode.
account_specification.literal_details: Object storing actual tool/form, education setting/activity, time horizon, country/locality/institution/scope and named actor details as stated. Do not add invented settings/times. Foreign domestic space codes require the actual country in space details.
account_specification.missing_notes: Object keyed by each MISSING field; short reason that the relevant specification is absent/insufficient in this account, not in unrelated article material.

note: Article codes summarise the primary account. Preserve attributed voices and linked evidence. Current taxonomy recoding inherits existing coding, with rule-assisted splits and targeted semantic review.

new_requirements.field_evidence: Object with all twelve field keys. Each substantive field code has one or more entries: {code, char_start, char_end, proposition_id, reason} for new records, locating a nonempty contiguous retained-source span without copying it. Previously stored {code, quote, proposition_id, reason} entries remain valid and unchanged. MISSING has an empty evidence array and a field-specific absence/limit note. Noneligible records have empty accounts/codes.
new_requirements.propositions: Nonempty array per eligible account: {proposition_id, statement, target, claim_mode}. IDs unique within account. The statement is a source-supported semantic summary; no assigned code or evaluation is inferred from claim_mode.
new_requirements.literal_details: Object storing actual tool/form, education setting/activity, time horizon, country/locality/institution/scope and named actor details as stated. Do not add invented settings/times. Foreign domestic space codes require the actual country in space details.
new_requirements.missing_notes: Object keyed by each MISSING field; short reason that the relevant specification is absent/insufficient in this account, not in unrelated article material.
new_requirements.role_details: Each assigned role/outcome has mechanism, direction, conditions and evidence_reference; retain literal AI role/function and goal/outcome in mechanism or proposition target. MISSING role has an empty role_details object.
new_requirements.desirability: One value per account evaluation target. Materially different desired/feared arrangements are separated when source supports their distinction. Mixed is one speaker’s same-arrangement weighing, not article-level disagreement.
new_requirements.primary_selection: Use the most central explicitly articulated educational future in the article lead/main argument. Record primary_selection_reason; do not choose by code frequency, positive valence or outlet group.

coverage: 1,081 retained articles; 3,004 inherited accounts. Rationale and the three actor positions updated in place; other fields preserved.
future_role_evidence_note: Exact source anchors and a contextual-link reason are stored directly in each revised account. Existing same-account evidence remains valid. Context identifies the target, without transferring evaluations across voices.

actor_fields.rule: Distinct concepts may overlap. Assign each field independently from evidence; MISSING remains exclusive.
